name: Mount Hamiguitan Range Wildlife Sanctuary
description: This forested mountain ridge runs along the Pujada Peninsula in Davao Oriental, on the island of Mindanao in the Philippines, rising from 75 m to about 1,600 m. Near the top, a stunted "pygmy forest" of century-old trees grows on metal-rich soil, alongside rare pitcher plants. The sanctuary shelters eight species found nowhere else, and it is home to the Philippine eagle and the Philippine cockatoo.
